name: Garden expansion
description: Unlock one more bed, up to 20. Market Courtyard opens at 9 beds; Lakeside Garden at 16. Existing prices follow the plot ladder.

name: Rich compost
description: New seeds grow 5% faster per level.

name: Gentle irrigation
description: New seeds grow 5% faster per level; stacks with compost.

name: Market baskets
description: All sales earn 5% more base value per level.

name: Flower stand
description: Automatically sell one harvested item every 10 seconds. Needs inventory.

name: Harvest helper
description: Harvest ready plants every 5 seconds. Does not plant seeds.

name: Stand signage
description: Stand sells 2 seconds sooner per level; requires a stand.

name: Learning garden
description: Harvests give 25% more base XP per level.
